# axm docs new

Scaffold a new docs package

## When to use

Scaffold a new docs package

## Usage

```bash
axm docs new [flags] <name>
```

## Arguments

| Name   | Type   | Required | Description              |
| ------ | ------ | -------- | ------------------------ |
| `name` | string | Yes      | Name of the docs package |

## Flags

| Name            | Type    | Required | Description                               |
| --------------- | ------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `--owner`       | string  | No       | Override the workspace owner (e.g. @acme) |
| `--yes`, `-y`   | boolean | No       | Create without confirmation               |
| `--force`, `-f` | boolean | No       | Overwrite if the directory exists         |
| `--preview`     | boolean | No       | Show files without creating them          |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Scaffold a docs package**

```bash
axm docs new workspace-baseline --owner @acme
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
